newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady, supported by firmer crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady, supported by firmer crude.

text.p: NWE naphtha held steady in quiet trade on Monday, bolstered by firmer crude.

But traders said the undertone was generally soft with very little buying interest seen. They said good fob avails of most grades kept petrochemical buying relaxed while a well-supplied gasoline market restricted reformer demand.
"We may see some fresh interest when the gasoline arb to the U.S.opens up again," one trade said.
Offers for pipeline spec were pegged around $186. A cargo was traded on Friday at $186.50 cif Antwerp after similar material made $192 earlier in the week.
Russian cargoes were thought still available at around $182.
Bids were assessed around $4-$6 under the cargo offers depending on quality.
